subject: general
question: Which of the following is a private sector bank in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Federal Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Federal Bank** is a major Indian commercial bank in the private sector headquartered in Aluva, Kochi, Kerala.
 
• It was **incorporated in 1931** and has a strong presence in India with over 1,200 branches and 1,600 ATMs spread across the country.
 
• The bank offers a variety of products and services including loans, savings and current accounts, debit and credit cards, and investment products.
 
• Federal Bank has been known for its significant contributions to the banking sector through technological innovations and customer-focused services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bank of Baroda**

 
 
• It is a public sector bank in India, owned by the government.
 
• It was founded on July 20, 1908, by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III.
 
• Headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, it is one of the largest public sector banks in India.
 
• It offers a wide range of banking products and financial services.
 
 
 
• **Punjab National Bank**
 
 
• It is another major public sector bank in India.
 
• Founded in 1894, it is one of the oldest banks in India.
 
• Headquartered in New Delhi, it has a wide network of branches and ATMs across the country.
 
• It provides a variety of banking and financial services to its customers.
 
 
 
• **UCO Bank**
 
 
• UCO Bank is a public sector bank established in 1943.
 
• Headquartered in Kolkata, it was formerly known as United Commercial Bank.
 
• It provides a wide range of banking products and services, including loans, deposits, and payment services.
 
• UCO Bank has a significant presence in India with numerous branches and ATMs.
